notes: GST: 'fine metal' (gold 99.5%+, silver 99.9%+) from a dealer or imported is an exempt supply (GST Act 1985); jewellery and sub-purity coins carry 15%. Premium is NZ Pure 1/2 oz bar vs same-morning spot (calculated). Used 10% is a floor: NZ Gold Merchants guarantees at least 90% of melt. Duty not verified, null. 9ct most popular by volume; 18ct fine standard.
